title: Bluetooth, AirPlay Pairing Vulnerabilities Patched Across Apple Platforms
description: Apple released security updates across multiple platforms to address 10 vulnerabilities, including Bluetooth and AirPlay pairing flaws, iMessage group chat issues, and an exploited Brotli bug. Several Bluetooth and AirPlay flaws allow attackers within Bluetooth range or on the same network to bypass pairing code limits or pair without user interaction. Two iMessage vulnerabilities could allow unauthorized access to group chats or earlier conversations. The updates cover iOS, iPadOS, macOS, watchOS, and visionOS with specific fixes for certain devices. No exploitation in the wild has been reported for these Apple-specific vulnerabilities.
